decisions.reason: The air fin cooler sits close to the core offer, and the firm is growing with slack resources, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it after one year.
The condenser fits the established portfolio and industry turnover is growing, so management sees no aspiration gap; its overlap with C makes it only slightly more likely to be consolidated.
This condenser is a near-duplicate of B and could be merged in a portfolio cleanup, but with expansion and slack there is little pressure to cut a core-adjacent line.
Tube liners support the firm's lifecycle service strategy and draw on its installed base, so it is a low-cost, aspiration-consistent offering worth keeping.
Customized air coolers express the firm's stated competitive strategy of integrated tailored solutions, so keeping them is the satisficing choice.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the service and spare-parts business and need few resources, so the firm has no reason to search for other uses of them.
